skus.nutrition_adjudication: DOWNGRADED candidate->not_characterized. Only a RAW USDA generic (fdc 169236) exists for Jerusalem artichoke; this SKU is frozen (cooked-use). It is an inulin tuber whose raw fiber/carbohydrate basis does not transfer honestly to a cooked-use display. No clean cooked/frozen generic -> micros not characterized, never synthesized from a raw-basis reference (Phase 1 §4).

ACCEPTED candidate->reviewed. A spinach medallion is mechanically pressed chopped frozen spinach: same botanical material and same 'spinach, frozen, chopped/leaf, cooked' generic already accepted for loose-leaf spinach. The pressed-disc form is a geometry change, not a composition change. Vit A/K/C are honest as typical-for-spinach reference.

ACCEPTED candidate->reviewed; micro question MOOT. Routes to band 4 (תיבול ובישול), where benefit_facts_allowed=[] and usda_filled_fields=[] — no micronutrient surfaces regardless of generic. Segment-routing confirmed: the globe-artichoke generic identifies the vegetable for identity only; no nutritional value is exposed, so the generic-fit question does not gate display.

ACCEPTED candidate->reviewed; micro question MOOT. Routes to band 4 (תיבול ובישול), where benefit_facts_allowed=[] and usda_filled_fields=[] — no micronutrient surfaces regardless of generic. Segment-routing confirmed: globe-artichoke generic is identity-only; no value exposed.

ACCEPTED candidate->reviewed. Green/immature soybeans (edamame, fdc 170530) is the CORRECT generic for פולי סויה — protein 12.35g and fiber 4.2g match the green-immature profile; mature soybeans would be ~16-18g protein / ~6g fiber, clearly distinct. Generic choice is right; fiber+folate fill missing label fields as typical-for-vegetable reference.
ACCEPTED candidate->reviewed. Green/immature soybean (edamame) generic confirmed correct vs mature soybeans; same basis as 7296073691358.

ACCEPTED candidate->reviewed. Shelled green soybean (edamame, קלופים) — green/immature generic confirmed correct; shelling is a form change, not a composition change relevant to fiber/folate reference.
ACCEPTED candidate->reviewed. Green/immature soybean (edamame) generic confirmed correct; this SKU carries its own label fiber, so USDA fills folate only as typical-for-vegetable reference.

phrasing_APPROVED._status: APPROVED by Nutrition Agent 2026-06-10 (Phase 1 §4 / Hard-rule 5). Source/confidence framing only — NOT final consumer copy (Phase 3, Content-led).
phrasing_APPROVED.generic_reference_label_he: ערכים אופייניים לירק זה (מקור ייחוס: USDA), לא נמדדו על המוצר עצמו.
phrasing_APPROVED.per_fact_framing_template_he: {ירק} מספק בדרך כלל ~{ערך} {יחידה} ל-100 גרם (ערך ייחוס גנרי, לא נמדד על המוצר).
phrasing_APPROVED.absent_value_he: ערך זה לא דווח במקור הייחוס — לא ידוע, ולא אופס.
phrasing_APPROVED.not_characterized_he: תערובת — אין ערך ייחוס גנרי נקי; ערכי המיקרו לא אופיינו ולא הומצאו.
phrasing_APPROVED.seasoning_reframe_he: תיבול — נשפט ככזה. הערכים מתייחסים לשימוש של כ-5 גרם (כפית), לא למנה נאכלת.
phrasing_APPROVED._phrasing_guardrails: Binding on any string built from these templates: present every USDA value as typical-for-the-vegetable reference, never as a per-product measured figure; a missing nutrient renders via absent_value_he, NEVER as 0; no rank, no 'best', no מומלץ/בריא יותר/כדאי, no health-outcome claim.

verified: 8 candidate joins adjudicated: 7 -> reviewed (spinach medallion; 2x globe-artichoke bottoms [micro question moot, band 4]; 4x green-soybean/edamame), 1 -> not_characterized (Jerusalem artichoke: raw-only generic, not honest for cooked-use).
edamame routed to green/immature soybean generic (fdc 170530), NOT mature soybeans — confirmed correct by protein/fiber profile.
'with salt' USDA variants affect sodium only; sodium is not surfaced from USDA for plain-veg/legumes, so no displayed value is distorted.
fava (פול ירוק) generic carries NO fiber key — confirmed it must display ABSENT (absent_value_he), never 0.
headline sanity checks pass: peas fiber 4.5g, edamame protein 12.35g, chickpea protein 8.86g/fiber 7.6g, parsley vit K 1640ug, spinach vit K 540ug — no unit/order-of-magnitude error.
phrasing strings carry no per-product claim, no rank/best, no recommendation language; added absent_value_he + guardrail note.
